project: S3000XL-VST — Akai S3000XL sampler wrapped as a VST3/AU instrument (MAME 0.288 core in a Sojus-style JUCE host)
protocol: A2A: the repo/source is the judge. Grep before claiming. The compiler & DAW are the judges. See MAME-to-VSTi-RECIPE.md.
version: STATE v3 (S3000XL) — v1.1: the DATA ENTRY dial is now an ENDLESS (wrapping) encoder.
DATA_ENTRY_DIAL_WRAP: The dial no longer clamps at either end. Four juce::jlimit(0,255,...) clamps were replaced with & 0xFF: the click step and the drag step in PluginEditor.cpp, the 'data_entry' parameter handler, and the OSD apply block that calls analog->set_value(). Rationale: PORT_BIT(0xff, 0x00, IPT_DIAL) gives the firmware an ABSOLUTE position from which it derives rotation, so wrapping 255->0 and 0->255 is what the hardware knob does — clamping made it feel like it hit a stop. The same design was implemented from scratch for the MPC3000 this round (see MPC3000_Port/STATE.json DATA_ENTRY_DIAL). User-verified in the host.

PUBLISHED.history_note: IMPORTANT: the local 'master' branch history CONTAINS the firmware ROM blob (added in fec8792, removed in ace78e3). It must NEVER be pushed. The public repo was created from an ORPHAN branch 'public' (pushed as origin/main) so no ROM object is reachable from anything published. Keep publishing from 'public'; if you ever need to publish master, purge the blob first (git filter-repo).
PUBLISHED.lcd_fix: LCD live-refresh FIXED (was the last open item): the OSD dirty-frame hash only mixed prim->texture.base (the bitmap ADDRESS). The LCD renders into the same buffer, so content changes (blinking cursor, load progress) left the hash unchanged and the frame was dropped -> 'refreshes only on events'. Fix: also hash prim->texture.seqid, which MAME bumps whenever a texture's CONTENT changes. VERIFIED: cursor blinks, display live.
PUBLISHED.stereo_fix: L7A1045 stereo voice-pair key-on fix applied (see mame-0288-l7a1045-stereo-pair-keyon.patch) — the same chip is shared with the MPC3000 family.

WORKING.panel_render: AKAI S3000XL panel from the MAME layout; buttons C0..C7 via hit-test -> buttonParams -> set_value; auto-generated clickmap (36 buttons + 2 dial zones).
WORKING.audio: FIXED (wave RAM persistence). Runtime reports 3 channels including the nested floppy speaker: ch0=floppy, ch1=L, ch2=R. Producer threshold uses max(Internal Buffer, host block size). Root cause of loaded-sample garble: the plugin saved/restored OS RAM and Seq RAM on state save/load but NOT the DSP wave RAM (32 MiB at s3000.cpp dsp_map). After a warm boot the firmware believed samples were loaded (OS RAM state intact) but the actual sample data was missing from the L7A1045's wave memory, so the DSP read garbage. Fix: expose wave RAM as a named share ("waveram") in s3000.cpp dsp_map, then save it (zlib-compressed) under ram_waveram in getStateInformation and inject it in the same pendingRamInjection path as osram/seqram. Standalone MAME Lua inspection confirmed no voices keyed on and zero mixer volumes after panel PLAY when wave RAM was empty.
WORKING.midi: VST MIDI in/out via the emulated UART; responsive.
WORKING.media: Floppy + CD + HDD. HDD (.chd) and CD (.iso via cdrom_2x) load samples CLEANLY. Floppy FIXED: s3000xl_io_map was missing the 74HC365 FDC status read at 0x0020-0x0023 (umask16 0xff00) that the S3000/CD3000i and MPC3000 maps have. Without fdc_hc365_r wired in, the firmware could not read floppy density (HD/DD) or disk-change, so floppy-loaded samples failed. Fix mirrors the S3000/MPC3000 hookup: map(0x0020, 0x0023).r(FUNC(s3000_state::fdc_hc365_r)).umask16(0xff00). See findings below.
WORKING.dial: DATA ENTRY = IPT_DIAL analog -> analog_field::set_value; click (+-1) + drag-to-turn + 'data_entry' VST param.
WORKING.params: 45 VST params (5 float + 38 button bool + 2 choice) exposed. Requires the unique pluginCode (see findings).

KEY_FINDINGS.audio_stride: MAME recording stride = sound().outputs_count(). S3000XL runtime reports 3, including a nested floppy-device speaker in addition to the driver's stereo speaker. Inspect the complete device tree, not only top-level SPEAKER declarations. Channel mapping and producer/consumer buffer sizing are separate correctness requirements.
KEY_FINDINGS.cd_timing: cdrom vs cdrom_2x share identity (Sony CDU-76S), differ ONLY in SCSI timing. The firmware needs cdrom_2x's paced 2x transfer to read a disc CLEANLY; plain cdrom is too fast -> corrupted sample data -> crackle. cdrom_2x does NOT slow emulation (186%). Use cdrom_2x when a disc is loaded, plain cdrom when empty.
KEY_FINDINGS.scsi_defaults: s3000xl PRE-POPULATES scsi:4=cdrom_2x, scsi:5=harddisk (MPC3000 leaves them empty). Don't blindly override pre-populated slots.
KEY_FINDINGS.media_lock: MAME opens harddisk .chd READ-WRITE EXCLUSIVE. A 2nd MAME instance (standalone MAMEUI) holding the same disk -> 'permission denied (generic:13)' -> fatal error. Don't run standalone MAME on the same disk while testing.
KEY_FINDINGS.graceful_bootfail: Check cli_frontend::execute() return; on failure set isMameRunning=false (no DAW freeze) + clear persisted media paths (no crash-loop).
KEY_FINDINGS.unique_plugincode: Each plugin needs a UNIQUE 4-char pluginCode. Shared code (both 'Mp30') = same VST3 UID = DAW confuses param caches (only Volume showed). S3000XL='S3kx', MPC3000='Mp30'.
KEY_FINDINGS.black_panel: Missing device ROM (hd61830.bin) -> MAME silently fails to start -> black panel. Include device ROMs in the self-check.
KEY_FINDINGS.floppy_status_read: s3000xl_io_map was missing the 74HC365 FDC status read that S3000/CD3000i and MPC3000 have at 0x0020-0x0023 (umask16 0xff00). fdc_hc365_r returns floppy_is_hd() | dskchg_r(); without it the firmware cannot detect HD/DD density or disk-change, so floppy sample loads fail. Fix: add map(0x0020, 0x0023).r(FUNC(s3000_state::fdc_hc365_r)).umask16(0xff00) to s3000xl_io_map.

OPEN_ITEMS.lcd_render_pump: The LCD only refreshes on events. OSD update() early-returned on skip_redraw (under -nothrottle MAME frameskips -> grab skipped). Decoupling from skip_redraw was applied but did NOT fully fix it. NEXT: pump the frame grab on a fixed cadence / drive video().frame_update() independent of MAME's frameskip.
OPEN_ITEMS.max_ram: Sample space is 32 MiB (.ram() at s3000.cpp L364). Confirm the v2.0 firmware sizes it (SIMM-ID probe); target 32 MiB, fallback 16 MiB.
OPEN_ITEMS.format_combos: F7+F8 (Format) and other 2-key combos are hard with mouse-only; plan: expose unused-CC button routing so a hardware controller can send them.
